notes.title: ICKLE, WHO KNEW, LIONPULSE & RIDER SHAFIQUE - Live in The Blueprint
notes.content:
[h2]Jump in! Experience live music in-game as real artists are beamed into The Blueprint in 3D. [/h2]

We've got a showcase of Bristol's finest underground vocalists for you this Thursday 2 November at 8PM GMT (doors open 7.45PM). ickle, WHO KNEW, Lionpulse and Rider Shafique will be performing LIVE in The Blueprint.

Head in and you'll be able to join the online event as an avatar and explore our virtual warehouse. The artists can see your avatars in the venue! So be sure to mash those emotes and you might get a shout out. 

Get your free tickets [url=https://s5.live/v/theblueprint/hold-tight-records-takeover]here[/url]

Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/bJvs6rD8yA]Discord server[/url] too. Here you can send messages to the artists during the performance and chat to other fans!

notes.title: ILLAMAN X PITCH 92 - Live in The Blueprint
notes.content:
[h2]Jump in! Experience live music in-game as real artists are beamed into The Blueprint in 3D. [/h2]

Hip hop duo [b]ILLAMAN[/b] and [b]PITCH 92[/b] are stepping into our virtual venue on Thursday 26 October for a live performance from 8pm BST (doors open 7.45pm BST). 

Head in and you'll be able to join the online event as an avatar and explore The Blueprint - our virtual warehouse. The artists can see your avatars in the venue! So be sure to mash those emotes and you might get a shout out. 

Get your free tickets [url=https://s5.live/v/theblueprint/illaman_x_pitch92]here[/url]

Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/bJvs6rD8yA]Discord server[/url] too. Here you can send messages to Illaman and Pitch 92 during the performance and chat to other fans!

[b]ABOUT THE ARTISTS[/b]
Illaman has a cult following across the globe and now fronts the immense punk/grime outfit Pengshui. Illa has toured with heavyweight acts such as Goldie, Foreign Beggars and Andy C with his appearances spanning many scenes and imprints. But his pair of EPs with Norm Oddity (Give Us A Smile and Ugly Days) exhibit his signature, free-flowing introspection. 

Producer Pitch 92 moved from Dublin to Manchester, by way of Germany and Switzerland, with Madlib and Dilla on loop. He and his MPC joined The Mouse Outfit in 2009, with his jazzy boom-bap becoming the nucleus of their iconic, first two albums. Seven years later, he left to pursue a solo career at High Focus Records. Pitch now sits on multiple albums with Verb T, as well as feature-stacked projects Lost In Space, 3rd Culture and Intervals.
